beats: This is Product Advisory Learning: courses, tools and audio for product managers, built around where you are today.
Your home shows your next best step: the course to do now, and what comes after it.
My growth compares your first skill check with your latest, area by area, and nudges you to retake it after ninety days.
Courses come in seven skill areas, at four levels each. A lesson mixes a short story, real data and practice.
Every lesson has a Listen button, so you can learn on a walk or a commute.
The course outline shows your progress, the key takeaways, and related listening.
My Toolkits keeps the work you do in the free tools, saved to your account. You can even score a scorecard as a team.
Listen and watch has every Product+ article, read aloud, with chapters.
And when your company joins, admins see team skills and progress, and can assign courses with due dates.
Start with the free skill check, then follow your next best step. Welcome to Product Advisory Learning.
